decisions.statement: Use the single production flow RequestIntake → PlanCompiler → ContextRuntime → SkillResolver → CapabilityBroker → ExecutionCoordinator → ProofRouter → RunStore → OutcomeReducer.

DeepSeek Harness uses DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md, native skill provider and Cordis MCP rows proven by profile dump-config; generic mcp.json is never native proof.
Five rules and eight public commands remain stable; removed communication modes/profile residue stay rejected.
The final gate runs npm ci, verify:all and CLI package-smoke once, followed by the real eight-host install/readback; no redundant standalone build/check/test is added.
Fourteen journeys remain in the matrix; agent-executable journeys run, GUI/login journeys get one bounded attempt and a compact human residual when unobservable.
Integration has a short KEEP/DROP changed-path manifest, a clean commit, fast-forward merge to main, pushed origin/main, observed CI and cleanup only after safety checks.
